'''Dyspeth''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that perpetually [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] within the shadow of a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Varada sector/Legends|Varada sector]]. Around [[900 BBY/Legends|900 BBY]], it was [[Colonist/Legends|settled]] by [[Human/Legends|Humans]], with a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual known as [[Twilight (individual)|Twilight]] forming the group of [[The Force/Legends|Force-users]] known as the [[Disciples of Twilight]] there. The group became the defenders of Dyspeth's inhabitants, and [[400 BBY/Legends|five centuries]] later, the moon was discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], with the natives of Dyspeth gradually re-entering the [[galactic community]].

==Description==
Dyspeth was a habitable [[Moon/Legends|moon]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] a remote and unremarkable [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LECG" /> in the [[Dyspeth system/Legends|Dyspeth system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Varada sector/Legends|Varada sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The moon perpetually fell within the shadow of the planet.<ref name="LECG" />

==History==
[[File:Disciple_of_Twilight.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Dyspeth was home to the Disciples of Twilight.]]
Dyspeth was originally settled little more than [[900 BBY/Legends|nine hundred years]] before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] by [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonists]] who wished to break away from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Shortly after the moon's colonization, a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] individual known only as [[Twilight (individual)|Twilight]], who was rumored to have been a former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] seeking a new beginning, attempted to unite other colonists who could access [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in order to help their society adapt to Dyspeth's conditions. In order to do so, Twilight used her own [[Force power/Legends|Force abilities]], and eventually, she became the founder of a group of Force-users known as the [[Disciples of Twilight]]. Although the group did not hold military or [[Politics/Legends|political]] power on the moon, its members became the guardians of Dyspeth's inhabitants over the subsequent [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]].<ref name="LECG" />

Although Dyspeth was forgotten by the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] soon after its settlement, around [[400 BBY/Legends|400 BBY]], after centuries of peaceful existence, the moon was rediscovered by a Republic survey team. Although the people of the moon were cautious of the motives of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] government, they re-entered the [[galactic community]] as quiet [[Merchant/Legends|traders]]. Afterward, the Disciples of Twilight gradually dispersed into the neighboring [[Star system/Legends|star systems]], with their motives apparently involving protecting the weak from abuse by the strong. Since most other worlds were more brightly illuminated than Dyspeth, the Disciples, who predominantly used the Force to manipulate light and shadows, found their abilities to be amplified when offworld. By [[137 ABY]], although the organization had gained new members over the preceding centuries, its membership was chiefly drawn from natives of Dyspeth.<ref name="LECG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dyspeth was introduced in the sourcebook ''[[Legacy Era Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]]<ref name="LECG" /> on [[March 17]], [[2009]]<ref name="Wizards">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/legacycampaignguide|text=''Legacy Campaign Guide''}}</ref> for use with the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="LECG" /> The [[August 18]], 2009<ref name="Penguin">{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/185066/the-essential-atlas-star-wars-by-daniel-wallace-and-jason-fry|text=The Essential Atlas: Star Wars}}</ref> reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Dyspeth system, and therefore the moon, in grid square I-20.<ref name="TEA" />
